capabilities: Create Markdown notes from pasted article, audio, or video links
Import public DocFerry share links, including attachments
Preview generated notes before saving, copying, or sharing
Manage public share links with passwords, expiry dates, and stop controls
Show account identity, membership tier, and usage counts
extras: Freemium: importing public DocFerry shares is free without an account, but Media-to-Note and owner sharing require DocFerry Pro. Processing runs on a hosted service, so unfinished jobs are kept for 24 hours. Still under Community plugin review and not in the official directory; manual testers of 0.1.3 are warned to follow a backup-first migration.
problem: Links worth keeping rot in chat threads or read-later apps instead of becoming searchable, editable Markdown notes inside the vault.

relations.evidence: One membership covers both MediaFerry and DocFerry

summary: Link-to-note importer that turns pasted article, audio, and video URLs into Markdown notes in the vault, with optional public DocFerry sharing.
